stem: ![](asset:P000564-stem-1)A system of three blocks is being pushed by a horizontal force F as shown. The horizontal surface is smooth, whereas the coefficient of friction between A-B and B-C is $\mu$. Find minimum value of F to prevent block B from slipping down?

assets.alt: Three blocks on a floor: A (2m) pushed by F, B (m) resting across the tops of A and C, and C (2m).
Blocks of 2m and 2m joined across the top by B (m), with F pushing the first block; on B, friction f₁ and f₂ up its ends, weight mg down, and horizontal forces 3F/5 and 2F/5.
